concept_uz: Oʻquvchi qiz «x − 5 = 7» ni yechib, beshni narigi tomonga oʻtkazadi. Bu harakatning nomi 1200 yil oldin Bagʻdodda al-Xorazmiy kitobida tugʻilgan: «al-jabr» — butunlash. Burilish: u manfiy sonni tan olmagan — «minus uchta qoʻy» yoʻq — shuning uchun minusni har doim narigi tomonga koʻchirgan. Oxirida tomoshabin oʻzi yechadi.

facts.claim: Taxminan 1200 yil oldin Bagʻdoddagi «Bayt ul-hikma» (Donishmandlik uyi) dunyoning eng katta ilmiy markazi edi; al-Xorazmiy u yerda ishlagan
Toʻliq ismi Muhammad ibn Muso al-Xorazmiy; matn uni «Xorazmdan chiqqan olim» deydi
«Al-jabr» — butunlash, tiklash: ayirilayotgan sonni ikkinchi tomonga oʻtkazish; x − 5 = 7 → x = 12
Al-Xorazmiy davrida manfiy sonlar qabul qilinmagan; «minus uchta qoʻy» mavjud emas — son bu miqdor: qoʻy, tanga, yer
Kitobda belgi yoʻq — na x, na tenglik ishorasi; «bir mol va oʻn ildiz oʻttiz toʻqqizga teng» deb soʻz bilan yozilgan
XII asrda kitob lotin tiliga oʻgirildi; yevropaliklar uni «al-jabr» deb atadi va undan «algebra» soʻzi chiqdi
Shogird va tangali mato — sahnalashtirish (dramatizatsiya), tarixiy daʼvo emas

style_line: Cinematic photoreal historical drama, warm oil-lamp and golden-hour light, rich ochre, deep green and indigo tones, soft haze and floating dust, 35mm film look; modern classroom scenes bright and natural. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a grand ninth-century library hall in Baghdad, a respectful historical reconstruction: tall pointed arches, carved wooden lattice screens, shelves of bound manuscripts and scrolls, low wooden desks with oil lamps and reed pens, patterned carpets, a sunlit courtyard with a small fountain beyond the arches. Manuscripts show only blurred, illegible marks. No people.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait, respectful historical reconstruction of a ninth-century Central Asian scholar about 45: calm intelligent face, dark beard with grey streaks, white turban, long deep-green robe with a wide INDIGO-BLUE SASH, a reed pen in his right hand, sitting at a low wooden desk with an oil lamp in a grand old library. Warm, wise expression.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait of a ninth-century apprentice boy about 16 in a grand old library: curious bright eyes, short dark hair under a small white cap, plain beige cotton robe with a RUST-ORANGE cloth belt, holding a small wooden tablet. Eager, slightly puzzled expression.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait of a modern Uzbek schoolgirl about 14: two dark braids with WHITE RIBBON BOWS, white school blouse and dark navy vest, a YELLOW PENCIL tucked behind her right ear, lively confident face, sitting in a bright modern classroom.

Change the scene: the same girl sits at a wooden school desk, leaning over an open notebook with a pencil in her hand; the page is covered in soft, blurred, unreadable pencil marks. Sunny classroom window behind her, other pupils softly blurred. Same face, same braids and ribbons, 9:16.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot in the same library hall: the scholar with the indigo sash and the apprentice with the rust-orange belt sit on a carpet facing each other across a dark cloth laid on the floor; a thin white cord divides the cloth into two halves, with small piles of copper coins on each side. Oil lamp light. Same faces, same light.

Change the scene: top-down close-up of the same dark cloth divided by the thin white cord. On the left side: a pile of copper coins and, a little apart from it, a small neat stack of exactly five coins. On the right side: a pile of copper coins. The scholar's hand, with the indigo sleeve edge visible, rests near the stack of five. Same light, 9:16.

Vertical 9:16 interior of a candle-lit stone library in twelfth-century Europe: a middle-aged translator in a plain brown hooded robe with a GREY ROPE BELT sits at a slanted wooden desk, copying from an old manuscript into a new leather-bound book with a quill. Rain on a narrow arched window. All writing is blurred and illegible.

lines.text: Iks minus besh yettiga teng. Beshni narigi tomonga oʻtkazaman — iks oʻn ikki!

scenes.prompt: Close-up, then a quick push-in: a pencil taps twice on a notebook page covered in soft, blurred, unreadable pencil marks; the schoolgirl draws a quick arrow and grins, tapping the pencil again. Audio: two sharp pencil taps, a classroom murmur, chalk on a board in the distance. The schoolgirl says quickly to herself in Uzbek with a bright, clear Uzbek girl's voice, about fourteen, quick and confident: "Iks minus besh yettiga teng. Beshni narigi tomonga o'tkazaman — iks o'n ikki!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bu harakatning nomi bor. Uni taxminan ming ikki yuz yil oldin Bagʻdodda bir olim kitobga yozgan.

scenes.prompt: Slow, majestic push-in through the great hall of the old library at golden hour: dust floating in light beams, scholars bent over manuscripts in the distance, a fountain murmuring in the courtyard beyond the arches. Audio: soft pages turning, distant water, a reed pen scratching. An off-screen old man says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried Uzbek male storyteller voice, about sixty: "Bu harakatning nomi bor. Uni taxminan ming ikki yuz yil oldin Bag'dodda bir olim kitobga yozgan." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Xorazmdan chiqqan olim — Muhammad ibn Muso al-Xorazmiy. U Donishmandlik uyida ishlardi.

An off-screen old man says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried Uzbek male storyteller voice, about sixty: "Xorazmdan chiqqan olim — Muhammad ibn Muso al-Xorazmiy. U Donishmandlik uyida ishlardi." lines.text: Yoʻq. Son — bu miqdor: qoʻy, tanga, yer.

scenes.prompt: The young apprentice leans over the counting cloth, frowning, holding up three fingers; the scholar smiles gently and shakes his head, pointing to the coins on the cloth. Audio: coins clinking softly, quiet library. The apprentice asks in Uzbek with a light, eager Uzbek teenage boy's voice, about sixteen, curious: "Ustoz, minus uchta qo'y bo'ladimi?" Then the scholar answers in Uzbek with a calm, warm, low Uzbek male voice of a scholar, about forty-five, kind and precise: "Yo'q. Son — bu miqdor: qo'y, tanga, yer." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Minus qolmasin. Ayirilganni narigi tomonga oʻtkazib, butunlaymiz. Buning nomi — al-jabr.

scenes.prompt: Top-down close-up of the counting cloth: the scholar's hand slides a small stack of five copper coins across the dividing cord from one side to the other, and taps the cord once. Calm, satisfying motion. Audio: coins sliding on cloth, one soft tap. The scholar, off-screen, says in Uzbek with a calm, warm, low Uzbek male voice of a scholar, about forty-five, kind and precise: "Minus qolmasin. Ayirilganni narigi tomonga o'tkazib, butunlaymiz. Buning nomi — al-jabr." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Kitobda na iks bor edi, na tenglik belgisi. Hammasi soʻz bilan yozilgan.

No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oʻn ikkinchi asrda kitob lotin tiliga oʻgirildi. Uzun nomdan bitta soʻz qoldi: al-jabr. Bugun biz uni algebra deymiz.

An off-screen old man says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried Uzbek male storyteller voice, about sixty: "O'n ikkinchi asrda kitob lotin tiliga o'girildi. Uzun nomdan bitta so'z qoldi: al-jabr. lines.text: Demak, algebra — Xorazmlik olim kitobining nomi! Sinab koʻring: iks minus toʻqqiz oʻn birga teng. Iks nechchi? Izohda yozing!
